# `probe_whirl3.py`

Trace ONE seed of whirl_to_policy frame by frame: every room/mode/level change and every B
press, so the 0x42 failure can be seen instead of inferred.

---

    python3 testing/probe_whirl3.py          # any cwd; the bootstrap chdirs to the repo root

## What it touches

- **drives BizHawk** - replays, searches or steps frames
- writes `shots/`
- loads savestate(s): `ckpt_fullgame_x9_out`
